entries.zh: 男儿独自自强（不靠他人帮扶而自立、进取向上）
entries.en: to know how to rise and get ahead without another's help; a man strong on his own
[source damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语栏残损存疑（selos cora 后[疑:cong/con]），音写多字标[疑]，仅汉字'相體'可读，四栏不足以定夺。

entries.zh: 懂得感恩（体识人情，善察他人情意）
entries.en: to know how to be grateful; to appreciate others' kindness (understand human feeling)
to know the heart; to know another's mind

entries.zh: 知一不知二（一知半解，所知不全）
entries.en: to know something imperfectly; knows one thing but not two (half-knowledge)

entries.zh: 很会、懂得透彻（原汉字'大下會'搭配罕见，据西语与音写定为'懂得好'义）
entries.en: to know well; to be thoroughly skilled
entries.notes: 汉字'大下會'非寻常搭配且首字声号污损，仅'會(ey)'与西语'Saber bien'相合，'大下'疑为强调成分或误写，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 洞察（明察，透彻知晓事物）
entries.en: to know something clearly; to see through a matter
to understand it; to comprehend thoroughly
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写'pdo'残损[残]，展开依赖推断；汉字'通晓'与音写 tong hiau 清晰互证，取'通晓'义。

entries.zh: 通晓明白（通透知解；能讲明事理）
entries.en: to know how to explain; to understand thoroughly and clearly

entries.zh: 通达（通晓事理，无所滞碍）
entries.en: to be thoroughly versed; to know how to explain
to know the road; to find one's way
entries.notes: 西语栏'lexica'拼写残损难解，据汉字'認路'与音写 xim lou 定为'认路'义。

entries.zh: 仙机（天机；仙人或上天的灵慧）
entries.en: heavenly wisdom; wisdom of the immortals
entries.notes: 西语栏大面积残损且含[疑][残]（er=pinu/ros/fus、penemar 不可解），仅据汉字'仙机'、音写 sien-quy 与残留的'del cielo'立义。

entries.en: wise; virtuous and worthy, sage
wise; sage, philosopher
entries.notes: 音写存疑[疑:Tit/fier]，据汉字'哲'（闽南音 tiat 一系）取 Tit 读法。

entries.en: [source damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字栏自身存疑（偉/倃），音写后半残损（g puide 不可解），西语仅'Sabio ~'，无法定夺释义。

entries.en: wise; intelligent
wise; to penetrate a matter thoroughly
masterful, eminent; (per its Spanish gloss: wise, penetrating)
entries.notes: 汉字'雄'与西语'sabio…lo penetra'义合较松，取'雄才/英杰'义；西语栏'g 200'疑为批注互见记号。

entries.zh: 英（英明，睿智而善治国政）
entries.en: wise and prudent, a good governor (of brilliant, heroic insight)
entries.notes: 音写栏'inlami、liña、chuñ'难解（疑杂有他条音写），据汉字'英'与西语'Sabio, prudente, buen gouierno'定为'英明'义。

entries.en: discerning and prudent; a mirror, exemplar
entries.notes: 音写后二字'cuay ca'难解（'cuay'疑为'乖'，聪明乖觉义），据汉字'鑑'与西语'Sabio prudente'立义。
